issues.quote: This Agreement has an initial term of five (5) years and renews automatically for successive periods of one (1) year unless either Party gives thirty (30) days' written notice of non-renewal.
issues.reason: Under ruling R-2026-01, the term measured against the three-year limit is the initial term, because either Party can stop the renewal by notice. The initial term is five years, which is more than the three years the playbook accepts. Survival of three years after the end is within the five-year limit. The NDA is mutual, has all five exclusions, allows retention for legal and back-up copies, and has no restrictive covenants or liquidated damages. DIFC law and forum are acceptable, and the NDA is English-only, so no translation issue arises.

issues.quote: is renewed automatically for further periods of three (3) years; it cannot be terminated before the end of a period
issues.reason: The initial term is 3 years, which is within the playbook limit. But the Agreement renews automatically for further 3-year periods, and no clause lets either Party stop the renewal by notice. Under ruling R-2026-01, TERM_TOO_LONG applies when the renewal cannot be stopped by notice. The Agreement could therefore run indefinitely, and the 3-year survival period would never start to run.
